subject: MAP follow-up: SOC 2 evidence commitments & security review checkpoints
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@finarch.com>, FinArch Security <security@finarch.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo MAP: next steps for security review & SOC 2 evidence

Hi Amanda —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Per our conversation I outlined a short MAP section focused on the security review and SOC 2 materials so your security and procurement teams have clear ownership and target dates. I attached a working MAP spreadsheet (MAP-Redwood-FinArch-v1.xlsx) and a zip of the SOC 2 package we typically share.

Proposed milestones (security-focused):
- Step 1 — Security questionnaire review (FinArch: complete redlines) — due 2027-05-09 — owner: FinArch Security
- Step 2 — Redwood provides full SOC 2 package (evidence bundle + signed attestation) — due 2027-05-11 — owner: Redwood (Marissa)
- Step 3 — Technical deep-dive (optional, infra call) — target week of 2027-05-17 — owner: Redwood (Jordan)
- Step 4 — Procurement/PO & contract signature — target 2027-05-28 — owner: FinArch Procurement

Dependencies called out:
- We need the completed questionnaire back to attach to the assurance file (FinArch security).
- Any additional evidence asks after your review (e.g., VPC network diagrams, retention proof) may add 3–5 business days to the schedule.

Next concrete asks from our side: could you confirm who on FinArch will own the questionnaire and whether they need a separate transfer link for the SOC 2 zip?

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MAP-Redwood-FinArch-v1.xlsx) (Attachment: Redwood_SOC2-package-v1.zip)

From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@finarch.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinArch Security <security@finarch.com>, Procurement Team <procure@finarch.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: next steps for security review & SOC 2 evidence

Thanks, Sean — this is helpful. Looping in our security lead (Chris) and procurement.

Chris — can you take the questionnaire and aim to return redlines by EOD 2027-05-09? Procurement — FYI on target signature date 5/28, will confirm PO timing.

Two quick clarifications from our side:
1) For the SOC 2 package, do you have a shorter evidence index (one page) that calls out which artifacts are sensitive (PII) so we can prepare an internal distribution list?
2) If we ask for a specific control sample (e.g., change-control tickets for the last 90 days), what is the expected turnaround?

Appreciate it —
Amanda
Director, Strategic Partnerships, FinArch Capital
(External)

On Mon, May 3, 2027 at 09:14 AM Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo earlier...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: FinArch Security <security@finarch.com>, Amanda Li <amanda.li@finarch.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: next steps for security review & SOC 2 evidence

Hi Amanda / Chris,

Thanks for looping us in. Quick answers to your clarifications:

1) We do have an evidence index summary — sending as part of the SOC 2 bundle. See attachment in the zip: soc2_evidence_index.md (high level: attestations, system config, access logs index, change-control summary, encryption certs).

2) For control samples like change-control tickets, our typical turnaround is 2–4 business days once you identify specific ticket IDs or a time window. If you need a more exhaustive export (e.g., all tickets touching auth services in last 90 days) plan for 5–7 business days.

Also added a few minor notes in the MAP spreadsheet:
- Marissa (Redwood) will own the SOC 2 attestation delivery (due 2027-05-11).
- Jordan (Redwood) will schedule the infra deep-dive and prep a short runbook for the call.

We can also provide a signed non-production access agreement for reviewers if that helps your team jump into logs quicker.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: FinArch-SOC2-questionnaire-filled.pdf - placeholder for completed questionnaire)

From: Chris Barton <security@finarch.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Amanda Li <amanda.li@finarch.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@finarch.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: next steps for security review & SOC 2 evidence

Thanks all — quick status update from security:
- Questionnaire: attaching our redlined version (Attachment: FinArch-SOC2-questionnaire-filled.pdf). We captured two clarifying asks (see inline comments):
  • Clarify retention windows for token logs (production tokens)
  • Provide a sanitized sample of change-control evidence for auth service (ticket IDs provided in comments)
- We accept the proposed dates but request the SOC 2 evidence bundle be delivered via the secure transfer link you mentioned (not regular email).

Procurement — we will try to have a draft PO ready by 2027-05-18; if procurement needs more time we will update the MAP.

Next actions (owner / due):
- Redwood (Marissa) to post SOC 2 bundle to secure transfer link — due 2027-05-11
- FinArch (Chris) to return any follow-up evidence asks by 2027-05-13
- Redwood (Jordan) to propose 2 optional times for infra deep-dive week of 2027-05-17

Chris Barton
Security Lead, FinArch Capital
(Attachment: FinArch-SOC2-questionnaire-filled.pdf)
